import copy, json
from work import evaluate
p={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}
cases=[
({'rows':[]},{'ok':True,'records':[],'errors':[]}),
({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':2,'unit':'cm'}]},{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'x','amount':0.02,'unit':'m'}],'errors':[]}),
({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':True},{'id':'y','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'z','amount':float('inf')}]},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]}),
({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':'bad','unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':1}]},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'unit'},{'row':2,'cause':'duplicate'}]}),
({'rows':[None,{'id':'','amount':1}]},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'id'}]})]
for request, expected in cases:
    request_before=copy.deepcopy(request); policy_before=copy.deepcopy(p)
    assert evaluate(request,p)==expected
    assert request==request_before and p==policy_before
with open('policy.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('requests.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('report.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(request,policy) for request in requests]
print('all checks passed')
